tagline: Eastern Seaboard gateway — marina depth + island day-trip volume, now linked to Bangkok by water.
summary: Pattaya sits ~2hr by road SE of Bangkok on the Eastern Seaboard, with Southeast Asia's largest marina (Ocean Marina) and heavy day-trip flow off Bali Hai Pier to Koh Larn. It is the anchor of the Eastern Seaboard cluster: the natural Gulf-gateway complement to Bangkok (a ~46 nm Pioneer II water line), the launch point for the Koh Larn and Koh Samet day-trips, and the eastern terminus of the cross-Gulf line from Hua Hin.

demand_signals.detail: Bali Hai Pier moves large daily volumes of day-trippers to nearby islands.
Ocean Marina Yacht Club — the largest marina in SE Asia — anchors charter, berthing and premium marine demand.
Eastern Seaboard tourism and EEC business travel create premium transfer demand; the ~46 nm water line beats the congested highway.
Eastern end of the government-validated Hua Hin<->Pattaya crossing.

use_cases: Pattaya <-> Koh Larn premium island transfer

journeys.note: Gateway line from the capital — beats the 2hr-plus highway.

navier_fit: Very high. Best existing marine infrastructure of the new clusters (Ocean Marina); short island corridors plus an in-range Bangkok gateway; clear premium WTP. Strong pedestal/charging partner case at the marina.
competitive_landscape: Conventional speedboats and ferries to Koh Larn; no premium electric option and no water link to Bangkok. Ocean Marina serves charters but not scheduled transfer.
seasonality: Peak: Nov-Mar cool season. The upper Gulf here is relatively sheltered vs the open lower-Gulf islands — a broader operating window.
regulatory_note: Thai cabotage + Marine Department licensing; Chonburi/EEC special economic zone may offer a pilot-friendly regulatory environment.

precedents.label: Ocean Marina Yacht Club
precedents.note: Largest marina in SE Asia — natural charging/berth partner

grab.super_app_fit: Grab in-app island day-trip bundles (boat + GrabCar from Bangkok) and marina concierge transfers.
grab.wedge: Day-trip island bundles and a Bangkok->Pattaya gateway hop in Grab — pairs the Bangkok deal with proven coastal corridors.
